# ChirplyMint

> ChirplyMint is Instagram DM and comment automation for Indian creators,
> coaches, and small businesses. When a follower comments your chosen
> keyword on a post or Reel, ChirplyMint automatically sends them a DM
> with your link, PDF, or an AI-generated reply. It also builds your
> link-in-bio page and captures leads. Freemium with INR pricing.

ChirplyMint turns Instagram comments into automated DMs (comment-to-DM
keyword automation), delivers lead magnets, replies with AI, and stores
captured leads — built and priced for the Indian market by NovaMint
Networks.
